segments.name: Building Materials Distribution
segments.description: Distributes building materials and engineered wood products to dealers and builders.
segments.evidence: 6 Table of Contents Segment Detail Building Materials Distribution Products We sell a broad line of building materials, including commodities; general line items such as siding, composite decking, doors and millwork, metal products, roofing, and insulation; and EWP.

segments.name: Wood Products
segments.description: Manufactures engineered wood products and plywood for home building.
segments.evidence: In our Wood Products segment, we manufacture laminated veneer lumber (LVL), I-joists, and laminated beams, which are collectively referred to as EWP.

revenueModel.text: Dealers, builders and industrial customers buy its building materials and engineered wood.
revenueModel.evidence: Our products are used in the construction of new residential housing, including single-family, multi-family, and manufactured homes, the repair-and-remodeling of existing housing, the construction of light industrial and commercial buildings, and other industrial applications.
